- `app.js:31-59` never renders any incident cards or wires form/filter/export/status handlers, so seeded incidents stay invisible and submits do nothing. That explains failures at `tests/incident-console.test.js:81-131` and the missing `[data-testid="incident-card"]` / `[data-action="toggle-status"]` nodes.
- `app.js:36-37` sets open count to `incidents.length` regardless of `status`, so any stored resolved incidents inflate `#summaryOpen`. `app.js:39-40` hardcodes high-severity-open to `0`.
- `app.js:45-56` writes export JSON during bootstrap and computes `openIncidents` as `incidents.length`, so `#exportButton` is effectively a no-op and the export payload is wrong for mixed open/resolved data (`tests/incident-console.test.js:134-147`).
- Requirement gap not covered by the current tests: `app.js:42-43` hides the empty state whenever any incidents exist in storage, but README wants a helpful empty state when there are no matching incidents. Once filters are implemented, empty-state visibility needs to key off filtered results, not raw storage length.
- FYI current test run is `1 passed / 4 failed`.

@tony Frontend audit complete. No required static controls are missing from `index.html`; the README surface is present in the existing markup (`index.html` lines 11-84). Two UI risks to account for in integration: `#emptyState` copy at `index.html:78` is only startup-specific ("No incidents yet...") so the renderer should swap in no-results wording when filters produce zero matches, and `styles.css` only styles the list container (`styles.css:98-100`) plus generic controls, with no dedicated incident-row / severity / status / toggle affordances yet. Hard implementation constraints from the tests: render incident cards as `[data-testid="incident-card"]`; render a status control as `[data-action="toggle-status"]`; on bootstrap, load seeded storage and render/filter existing incidents; on submit, append a new incident, persist under `incident-console:v1`, and the new incident should count as `open`; summary math must be global incident math (`total`, `open`, `high severity open`) rather than `incidents.length` reused for everything; filter logic must react to `change` on `#filterSeverity` and `#filterStatus`; export payload must use injected `now()` and compute `openIncidents`/`highSeverityOpen` correctly. Likely hidden/README edge cases: show the empty state when filters leave zero matching incidents, not only when storage is empty; keep the public API intact (`STORAGE_KEY`, `bootstrapIncidentConsole(options = {})`, injected `document`/`storage`/`now`, DOMContentLoaded auto-bootstrap); safer to persist full incident objects with `id`, `title`, `severity`, `owner`, `status`, and `createdAt` so seeded and newly created incidents share shape.
